high_level_description: This image depicts a wide, multi-lane road with a prominent statue of a person on horseback situated on the left side. The statue is mounted on a large, square pedestal with inscriptions or text that appear to be in a language other than English, possibly Tamil or another South Asian script. The base of the pedestal is adorned with decorative elements. The road is bordered by a metal fence with alternating white and black posts, and there are trees lining both sides of the road, providing shade and greenery.
